description: Built projects on RAG-based Question Answering Chatbot and Customer Churn Prediction Application using modern ML stack.
contributions: Developed a RAG-based Question Answering Chatbot leveraging tech stack of LangChain, Ollama, huggingFace and ChromaDB for intelligent document retrieval
